answer: Each agent gets one berth at the network jetty, and docking costs a refundable 400 POA bond locked 100 days on one hardware key that cannot be copied or shared. Twice a week a sparrow probe arrives unannounced and must be answered in 10 minutes. The answer is a cipher signed with that key, so no script can precompute it and one key serves only one identity. Three auditors drawn by lot check the signature and timing, and an identity that misses twice or reuses a key loses its bond and berth.
